analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Performance should be read alongside geography and provider context rather than as a single national headline.
Workforce demand and salary pressure can affect mobilisation capacity and service consistency.
Historic delivery patterns can provide useful context for future employment-support commissioning and bid strategy.
